tool: Meshy text-to-3D API (POST /openapi/v2/text-to-3d, preview then refine), then Blender 5.2.3 LTS headless (scripts/blender/street_props.py): join, weld UV seams, drop floating parts, recalc normals, smooth by angle 30 deg, scale to meters, origin at bottom center, +z forward / +y up, Draco GLB export
pipeline: node scripts/assets/meshy-street-props.mjs (needs MESHY_API_KEY in env; raw downloads go to .meshy-raw/, git-ignored)
license: Generated with the project owner's Meshy account; usage is governed by Meshy's terms of service for that account.
format: GLB, POSITION + NORMAL + TEXCOORD_0, PBR material with 3 JPEG textures, KHR_draco_mesh_compression (needs a DRACOLoader, as in src/render/skater-model.js). sedan and pickup: body plus 4 wheel meshes and the wheels_roll clip; the rest: one mesh
style: Realistic mid-2010s Atlanta street, no branding (prompts forbid logos and text)
verify: node scripts/assets/street-props-check.mjs --out preview.png <glb...> loads the files in headless Chromium with GLTFLoader + DRACOLoader
asset: Street traffic vehicles for Skate ATL: sedan, bus, pickup. Lengths match CAR_SIZE in src/sim/traffic/traffic.js.

sedan.glb.prompt: Realistic mid-2010s midsize four-door sedan car, generic unbranded design, dark blue metallic paint, tinted glass windows, black tires with silver alloy wheels, headlights and red taillights, closed doors, complete single vehicle, no logos, no badges, no text, no lettering, no branding
sedan.glb.texture_prompt: Dark blue metallic car paint, dark tinted glass, black rubber tires, silver alloy rims, black plastic trim, clear headlights, red taillights, blank license plate, no logos, no badges, no text, no lettering, no branding
sedan.glb.textures: baseColor, metallicRoughness, normal; 2048 from Meshy, downscaled to 1024 JPEG

rig.nodes: body > steer_FL > wheel_FL, body > steer_FR > wheel_FR, body > wheel_RL, body > wheel_RR
rig.usage: rotate steer_* about y to steer; spin wheel_* about local x (positive rolls forward, toward +z)
rig.animation: wheels_roll: one wheel turn per second, linear, loopable
